svg.title: Predicted and measured effect of the fastest action
svg.desc: The usual order is 100 percent. Time from implementation to team review: the model predicted 78.3 percent; measured, it was 84.3 percent with waits and stalls removed and 50.3 percent as recorded. Agent and test spending per change: the model predicted 109.9 percent; measured at similar change sizes with stall recovery removed, it was 87.3 percent, and 54.3 percent as recorded. The spending difference is not statistically clear. Spending excludes human review.
